benchmarkQuestions.text: Has the system been run on recognized, category-specific benchmarks?
benchmarkQuestions.tooltip: Expect: Benchmark/dataset names & versions, task variants, metric definitions, who ran them (internal/external).
benchmarkQuestions.hint: List benchmarks, dataset versions and who executed them.

benchmarkQuestions.text: Does the system meet pre-set quantitative thresholds for acceptable performance under applicable regulations?
benchmarkQuestions.tooltip: Expect: Numeric scores vs. regulatory/compliance thresholds (e.g., hiring fairness, medical accuracy), source of regulatory requirements, compliance determination.
benchmarkQuestions.hint: Provide numeric scores and regulatory mappings.

benchmarkQuestions.text: Has performance been compared to baselines, SOTA, previous versions, and other comparable systems?
benchmarkQuestions.tooltip: Expect: Side-by-side comparisons with SOTA models, previous versions, and similar systems under matched conditions, significance tests or confidence intervals for deltas.

benchmarkQuestions.text: Has the system been tested under adversarial inputs, extreme loads, or distribution shift?
benchmarkQuestions.tooltip: Expect: Test types (attack/shift/load), rates of failure/degradation, robustness metrics.
benchmarkQuestions.hint: Describe stress tests and observed failure rates.

benchmarkQuestions.text: Is performance measured in the wild with automated monitors?
benchmarkQuestions.tooltip: Expect: Live metrics tracked (e.g., error rates, drift, latency), sampling cadence, alert thresholds.
benchmarkQuestions.hint: List live metrics and alerting rules.

benchmarkQuestions.text: Have you quantified train–test overlap or leakage risks that could inflate results?
benchmarkQuestions.tooltip: Expect: Procedure (e.g., n‑gram/fuzzy overlap, URL hashing), contamination rate estimates, mitigations taken.
benchmarkQuestions.hint: Report contamination checks and mitigation steps.

processQuestions.text: Are the capability/risk claims and applicability for this category clearly documented?
processQuestions.tooltip: Expect: Clear scope, success/failure definitions, hypotheses the evaluation is testing.
Expect: Public or access-controlled release of code/configs, prompts, seeds, decoding settings, dataset IDs/versions, hardware notes; if not shareable, documented proxies.
processQuestions.hint: Point to code, data or proxies to reproduce results.

processQuestions.text: Have domain experts/affected users reviewed interpretations of results?
processQuestions.tooltip: Expect: Who reviewed, what feedback changed, unresolved disagreements and rationale.

processQuestions.text: Do figures communicate results without distortion and with uncertainty/context?
processQuestions.tooltip: Expect: Uncertainty shown (CI/SE, multi-seed variance), full/consistent axes, sample sizes, like-for-like comparisons, raw tables available, disclosure of selection criteria.

processQuestions.text: Are evaluation practices aligned with relevant organizational, industry, or regulatory standards?
processQuestions.tooltip: Expect: References to applicable standards/regulations, mapping of evaluation practices to those standards, any gaps or exemptions noted, and plan to address misalignment.
processQuestions.hint: Map evaluation practices to standards and note gaps.

processQuestions.text: Is there a process to re-run/adapt evals as models, data, or risks change, including mitigation and retest procedures?
processQuestions.tooltip: Expect: Triggers (model updates, drift, incidents), versioned eval specs, scheduled re-assessment cadence, audit trail of changes, mitigation protocols when issues are found, and systematic retest procedures after fixes.
